        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async  {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Check if user already has a linked profile\n      // Once linked, email changes are not allowed to maintain profile connection\n      const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n      if (hasProfile) {\n        setError(\"Cannot change email address once linked to a profile. Your email is used to maintain your profile connection.\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate CZU domain\n      if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(email.trim())) {\n        setError(\"Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n\n      // Construct the redirect URL with next parameter if available\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; so Supabase can append token_hash\n      const confirmUrl = new URL(&#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/confirm-email-change&#96;);\n      if (next) {\n        confirmUrl.searchParams.set(\"next\", next);\n      }\n\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; for token_hash to be appended\n      let redirectUrl = confirmUrl.toString();\n      if (confirmUrl.search === \"\") {\n        // No query parameters, add ? for token_hash\n        redirectUrl += \"?\";\n      } else {\n        // Has query parameters, ensure it ends with &amp; for token_hash\n        if (!redirectUrl.endsWith(\"&amp;\")) {\n          redirectUrl += \"&amp;\";\n        }\n      }\n\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser\n;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n      }\n\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser(\n        {\n          email: email.trim(),\n        },\n        {\n          emailRedirectTo: redirectUrl,\n        },\n      );\n\n      if (updateError) {\n        // If email already exists, that's actually fine - it means it might already be linked\n        // or we need to handle it differently\n        if (updateError.message?.includes(\"already registered\")) {\n          setError(\"This email is already registered.         "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n  const verifyOTP = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n\n    // Track the OTP being submitted to prevent re-submission\n    setLastSubmittedOtp(trimmedOtp);\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: trimmedOtp,\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n        // The code remains in the input so user can see what they entered\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Clear persisted state on success\n      clearPersistedState();\n\n      // Success - redirect to next parameter or default page\n      const redirectTo = next ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n      router.push(redirectTo);\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n    }\n  }, [email, otpCode, next, supabase, router]);\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    await verifyOTP();\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Loads persisted state from sessionStorage after component mounts (client-side only)\n   * This prevents hydration mismatches between server and client\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "export async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n\n    // Parse the redirect URL to handle query parameters properly\n    const redirectUrl = new URL(redirectTo, origin);\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = redirectUrl.pathname;\n    url.search = redirectUrl.search;\n    url.hash = redirectUrl.hash;\n\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  } else {\n    // User needs to verify email, preserve next parameter\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    if (validatedNext) {\n      // Properly encode the next parameter\n      url.searchParams.set(\"next\", validatedNext);\n    }\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Form component for email verification via OTP\n * Allows users to link an email identity to their Google OAuth account\n */\nexport function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState(\"\");\n  const [step, setStep] = useState&lt;\"email\" | \"otp\"&gt;(\"email\");\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isHydrated, setIsHydrated] = useState(false);\n  const [lastSubmittedOtp, setLastSubmittedOtp] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const supabase = createClient();\n\n  /**\n   * Sends OTP code to the provided email\n   * Uses updateUser to add email identity to the current authenticated user\n   * This is the correct way to link an email identity to an existing OAuth account\n   */\n  const handleSendOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n;\n}",

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  createSuccessUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid type\"));\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid token hash\"));\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  return redirectWithCookies(createSuccessUrl(request, next), supabaseResponse);\n}",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./supabase/migrations/20260131230000_broadcast_verified_work_email_changes.sql",

        "contents": "begin\n  -- Only proceed if verified_work_email actually changed\n  if old.verified_work_email is not distinct from new.verified_work_email then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n\n  -- Get the auth_user_id for this user record\n  v_user_id := new.auth_user_id;\n\n  -- If no auth_user_id, cannot broadcast\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n\n  -- Get old and new email values\n  v_old_email := old.verified_work_email;\n  v_new_email := new.verified_work_email;\n\n  -- Broadcast to user-specific channel: user:{auth_user_id}:verification\n  -- This allows all devices for this user to receive the notification\n  -- Function signature: realtime.send(payload jsonb, event text, topic text, private boolean DEFAULT true)\n  perform realtime.send(\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'user_id', v_user_id,\n      'old_email', v_old_email,\n      'new_email', v_new_email,\n      'verified_at', new.verified_work_email_at,\n      'timestamp', now()\n    ),\n    'verified_work_email_changed',\n    'user:' || v_user_id::text || ':verification',\n    true -- private channel\n  );\n\n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.broadcast_verified_work_email_change() is 'Trigger function that broadcasts verified_work_email changes via Realtime to user-specific channel. Enables cross-device synchronization when email verification completes.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on users table to broadcast verified_work_email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure the change is committed\ndrop trigger if exists broadcast_verified_work_email_change_trigger on public.users;\n\ncreate trigger broadcast_verified_work_email_change_trigger\nafter update of verified_work_email on public.users\nfor each row\nwhen (old.verified_work_email is distinct from new.verified_work_email)\nexecute function public.broadcast_verified_work_email_change();\n\ncomment on trigger broadcast_verified_work_email_change_trigger on public.users is 'Broadcasts verified_work_email changes via Realtime to enable cross-device synchronization.';\n\n-- ============================================================================",

{\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code);\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has email identity linked\n  // If not, redirect to verify-email page\n  // Use the same supabase client to ensure we have the just-exchanged session\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n\n  // Validate the next parameter to prevent open redirects\n  const validatedNext = validateRedirectUrl(next, origin);\n\n  if (hasEmail) {\n    // User has email identity, redirect to next or default page\n    const redirectTo = validatedNext ??         "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { cn } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\nexport function ForgotPasswordForm({\n  className,\n  ...props\n}: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef&lt;\"div\"&gt;) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleForgotPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const supabase = createClient();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      // The url which will be included in the email. This URL needs to be configured in your redirect URLs in the Supabase dashboard at https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/auth/url-configuration\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {\n        redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/update-password&#96;,\n      });\n      if (error) throw error;\n      setSuccess(true);\n    } catch (error: unknown) {\n      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"An error occurred\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className={cn(\"flex flex-col gap-6\", className)} {...props}&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "  v_domain text;\nbegin\n  -- Determine which email to use: prefer new.email, fall back to email_change if email didn't change\n  -- When email_change is verified, Supabase typically:\n  -- 1. Sets email_change to the new email (temporary)\n  -- 2. Verifies OTP\n  -- 3. Moves email_change to email and clears email_change\n  -- So we need to check both fields\n  \n  -- Check if email changed\n  if old.email is distinct from new.email then\n    v_email := new.email;\n  -- Check if email_change was cleared (moved to email)\n  elsif old.email_change is distinct from new.email_change and (new.email_change is null or new.email_change = '') then\n    -- email_change was cleared, use the current email\n    v_email := new.email;\n  else\n    -- No relevant change\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and not empty\n  if v_email is null or v_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Extract domain from email\n  v_domain := lower(split_part(v_email, '@', 2));\n  \n  -- Only update verified_work_email if domain is a CZU domain\n  if v_domain not in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz') then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Update verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at\n  -- This happens after OTP verification succeeds, so the email is verified\n  -- Only update if the email is different from what's already stored (or not set)\n  update public.users\n  set verified_work_email = v_email,\n      verified_work_email_at = now()\n  where id = v_user_id\n    and (verified_work_email is null or verified_work_email != v_email);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change() is 'Trigger function that automatically sets verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at in public.users when auth.users.email is successfully changed to a CZU domain (@pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz). Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios. Runs after OTP verification succeeds.';\n\n-- ============================================================================",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  // Treat errors as \"no identity\" to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n  const emailIdentityCheck = await safeCheck(\n    () =&gt; hasEmailIdentity(supabase),\n    \"hasEmailIdentity\",\n  );\n  if (!emailIdentityCheck.ok) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  // Treat errors as \"no profile\" to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n  const linkedProfileCheck = await safeCheck(\n    () =&gt; hasLinkedProfile(supabase),\n    \"hasLinkedProfile\",\n  );\n  if (!linkedProfileCheck.ok) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Strip all query parameters (e.g., from email verification or QR code)\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Strip hash as well\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Broadcast verified_work_email changes via Realtime\n-- Purpose: Enables cross-device synchronization by broadcasting verified_work_email changes to all user sessions\n-- Affected tables: users, realtime.messages\n-- Special considerations: Uses Realtime broadcast to notify all devices when email verification completes\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to broadcast verified_work_email changes via Realtime\n-- Broadcasts to user-specific channel when verified_work_email changes\n-- Uses realtime.send to broadcast custom event with verification details\ncreate or replace function public.broadcast_verified_work_email_change()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth, pg_catalog\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_old_email text;\n  v_new_email text;\nbegin\n  -- Only proceed if verified_work_email actually changed",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Set verified work email when email change succeeds\n-- Purpose: Automatically sets verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at in public.users when auth.users.email is successfully changed to a CZU domain\n-- Affected tables: users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically after email change is committed, only for CZU domains (@pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz)\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to set verified work email when email change succeeds\n-- Updates public.users.verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at when auth.users.email changes to a CZU domain\n-- Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\ncreate or replace function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_email text;\n  v_domain text;\nbegin\n  -- Determine which email to use: prefer new.email, fall back to email_change if email didn't change",

        "contents": "  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change() is 'Trigger function that automatically sets verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at in public.users when auth.users.email is successfully changed to a CZU domain (@pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz). Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios. Runs after OTP verification succeeds.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to set verified work email when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\n-- Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios\ndrop trigger if exists set_verified_work_email_on_change_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger set_verified_work_email_on_change_trigger\nafter update of email, email_change on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (\n  (old.email is distinct from new.email) or \n  (old.email_change is distinct from new.email_change)\n)\nexecute function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change();\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA UPDATE\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Update existing users who already have a CZU email set\n-- This handles any existing data that should have verified_work_email set\nupdate public.users u\nset verified_work_email = au.email,\n    verified_work_email_at = au.updated_at\nfrom auth.users au\nwhere u.auth_user_id = au.id\n  and au.email is not null\n  and au.email != ''\n  and lower(split_part(au.email, '@', 2)) in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz')\n  and (u.verified_work_email is null or u.verified_work_email != au.email);",

      "codeBlock": {
        "relativeWorkspacePath": "./.cursor/plans/work_email_auth_system_467a2b18.plan.md",

          "startPosition": {

        "contents": "## Supabase Configuration Changes\n\nUpdate [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;toml\n[auth]\nenable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking\nenable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access\n\n[auth.email]\nenable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup\nenable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation\n\n[auth.external.google]\nenabled = true\nclient_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"\nsecret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)\n\nAll verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:\n\n- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id\n- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;\n- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)\n\nThis approach:\n\n- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)\n- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)\n- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification\n- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)\n\n## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP\n\nThe project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:\n\n1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally\n2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data\n3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks\n\n**Useful MCP commands for development:**\n\n- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing\n- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables\n- Test profile linking and access revocation queries\n\n## Key Security Features\n\n### Supabase (Data Layer Only)\n\n1. **Database Constraints**:\n\n   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles\n   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id\n\n2. **No RLS or Functions**:\n\n   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions",
        "signatures": {},
        "detailedLines": [
          {
            "text": "## Supabase Configuration Changes",
            "lineNumber": 194
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 195
          },
          {
            "text": "Update [&#96;supabase/config.toml&#96;](supabase/config.toml):",
            "lineNumber": 196
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 197
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;toml",
            "lineNumber": 198
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth]",
            "lineNumber": 199
          },
          {
            "text": "enable_manual_linking = true        # Required for work email linking",
            "lineNumber": 200
          },
          {
            "text": "enable_anonymous_sign_ins = false   # Block anonymous access",
            "lineNumber": 201
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 202
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth.email]",
            "lineNumber": 203
          },
          {
            "text": "enable_signup = false               # Block direct email/password signup",
            "lineNumber": 204
          },
          {
            "text": "enable_confirmations = false        # We use OTP for work email, not signup confirmation",
            "lineNumber": 205
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 206
          },
          {
            "text": "[auth.external.google]",
            "lineNumber": 207
          },
          {
            "text": "enabled = true",
            "lineNumber": 208
          },
          {
            "text": "client_id = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID)\"",
            "lineNumber": 209
          },
          {
            "text": "secret = \"env(GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET)\"",
            "lineNumber": 210
          },
          {
            "text": "&#96;&#96;&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 211
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 212
          },
          {
            "text": "### Profile Verification (Next.js Middleware)",
            "lineNumber": 213
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 214
          },
          {
            "text": "All verification logic lives in Next.js middleware, not in Supabase:",
            "lineNumber": 215
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 216
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Profile Linked**: Check &#96;profiles.user_id&#96; matches current auth.user.id",
            "lineNumber": 217
          },
          {
            "text": "- **Access Active**: Check &#96;profiles.removed_access IS NULL&#96;",
            "lineNumber": 218
          },
          {
            "text": "- **User Role**: Read &#96;profiles.role&#96; column (student, team_leader, coach, admin)",
            "lineNumber": 219
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 220
          },
          {
            "text": "This approach:",
            "lineNumber": 221
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 222
          },
          {
            "text": "- Keeps all business logic in Next.js (single source of truth)",
            "lineNumber": 223
          },
          {
            "text": "- Allows real-time updates (e.g., instant access revocation)",
            "lineNumber": 224
          },
          {
            "text": "- Admin pre-creates profiles, users link via work email verification",
            "lineNumber": 225
          },
          {
            "text": "- Supabase only handles auth + data storage (no custom hooks or functions)",
            "lineNumber": 226
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 227
          },
          {
            "text": "## Development &amp; Testing with Supabase MCP",
            "lineNumber": 228
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 229
          },
          {
            "text": "The project has a &#96;supabase/&#96; directory with Supabase MCP (Model Context Protocol) integration available for:",
            "lineNumber": 230
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 231
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Running migrations**: Apply and test database schema changes locally",
            "lineNumber": 232
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **Debugging auth flow**: Inspect user sessions and profile data",
            "lineNumber": 233
          },
          {
            "text": "3. **Testing verification logic**: Query profiles table for auth checks",
            "lineNumber": 234
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 235
          },
          {
            "text": "**Useful MCP commands for development:**",
            "lineNumber": 236
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 237
          },
          {
            "text": "- Seed test data into profiles table for auth testing",
            "lineNumber": 238
          },
          {
            "text": "- Inspect auth.users and profiles tables",
            "lineNumber": 239
          },
          {
            "text": "- Test profile linking and access revocation queries",
            "lineNumber": 240
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 241
          },
          {
            "text": "## Key Security Features",
            "lineNumber": 242
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 243
          },
          {
            "text": "### Supabase (Data Layer Only)",
            "lineNumber": 244
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 245
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **Database Constraints**:",
            "lineNumber": 246
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 247
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Domain constraint ensures only valid CZU domains in profiles",
            "lineNumber": 248
          },
          {
            "text": "   - Unique constraints on work_email, user_id",
            "lineNumber": 249
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 250
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **No RLS or Functions**:",
            "lineNumber": 251
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 252
          },
          {
            "text": "   - No Row Level Security policies",
            "lineNumber": 253
          },
          {
            "text": "   - No database triggers or functions",
            "lineNumber": 254
          }
        ]
      },

        "contents": "-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_auth_email text;\nbegin\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\n  v_auth_email := new.email;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and has changed\n  if v_auth_email is null or v_auth_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Link profile to user if work_email matches auth.users.email\n  -- Only update if profile exists and is not already linked to a different user\n  -- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\n  update public.profiles\n  set user_id = v_user_id\n  where lower(trim(work_email)) = lower(trim(v_auth_email))\n    and (user_id is null or user_id = v_user_id);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n  const verifyOTP = useCallback(async () =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n\n    // Track the OTP being submitted to prevent re-submission\n    setLastSubmittedOtp(trimmedOtp);\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Verify OTP code for email change/linking\n      // Use type 'email_change' because we used updateUser() to initiate the flow\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // to the current authenticated user instead of creating a new user\n      const { error: verifyError } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n        email: email.trim(),\n        token: trimmedOtp,\n        type: \"email_change\",\n      });\n\n      if (verifyError) {\n        setError(verifyError.message || \"Invalid OTP code\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n        // The code remains in the input so user can see what they entered\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Refresh session to ensure identities are updated\n      await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n      // Clear persisted state on success\n      clearPersistedState();\n\n      // Success - redirect to next parameter or default page\n      const redirectTo = next ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n      router.push(redirectTo);\n      router.refresh();\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n      // Keep lastSubmittedOtp set to prevent re-submission of the same code\n    }\n  }, [email, otpCode, next, supabase, router]);\n\n  /**\n   * Handles form submission for OTP verification\n   */\n  const handleVerifyOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    await verifyOTP();\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Loads persisted state from sessionStorage after component mounts (client-side only)\n   * This prevents hydration mismatches between server and client\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { VerifyEmailForm } from \"@/components/verify-email-form\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"@/components/logout-button\";\nimport { EmailVerificationRealtimeListener } from \"@/components/email-verification-realtime-listener\";\nimport { hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Email verification page\n * Users can link an email via OTP to their Google OAuth account\n * Users with existing email identities can also access this page to add additional emails\n */\nexport default async function VerifyEmailPage({\n  searchParams,\n}: {\n  searchParams: Promise&lt;{ next?: string }&gt;;\n}) {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Get search params once\n  const params = await searchParams;\n  const next = params.next;\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  // Respect the next parameter if provided, otherwise use default logged in page\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(next ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10 relative\"&gt;\n      &lt;EmailVerificationRealtimeListener /&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"absolute top-6 right-6 md:top-10 md:right-10\"&gt;\n        &lt;LogoutButton /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n      &lt;div className=\"w-full max-w-sm\"&gt;\n        &lt;VerifyEmailForm next={next} /&gt;\n      &lt;/div&gt;\n    &lt;/div&gt;\n  );\n}",

        "contents": "import { type EmailOtpType } from \"@supabase/supabase-js\";\nimport { createServerClient } from \"@supabase/ssr\";\nimport {\n  createErrorUrl,\n  createSuccessUrl,\n  redirectWithCookies,\n} from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\n\n/**\n * Handles email change confirmation callback using PKCE flow with token_hash\n * Verifies the OTP token and redirects appropriately\n * Ensures cookies are properly set before redirecting\n */\nexport async function GET(request: NextRequest) {\n  const { searchParams } = new URL(request.url);\n  const token_hash = searchParams.get(\"token_hash\");\n  const typeParam = searchParams.get(\"type\");\n  const next = searchParams.get(\"next\");\n  const type: EmailOtpType | null =\n    typeParam === \"email_change\" ? (\"email_change\" as EmailOtpType) : null;\n\n  if (!type) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid type\"));\n  }\n  if (!token_hash) {\n    return NextResponse.redirect(createErrorUrl(request, \"Invalid token hash\"));\n  }\n  let supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n    request,\n  });\n\n  const supabase = createServerClient(\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!,\n    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY!,\n    {\n      cookies: {\n        getAll() {\n          return request.cookies.getAll();\n        },\n        setAll(cookiesToSet) {\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) =&gt; {\n            request.cookies.set(name, value);\n          });\n          supabaseResponse = NextResponse.next({\n            request,\n          });\n          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) =&gt; {\n            supabaseResponse.cookies.set(name, value, options);\n          });\n        },\n      },\n    },\n  );\n\n\n  const { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n    type,\n    token_hash,\n  });\n  if (error) {\n    return redirectWithCookies(createErrorUrl(request, error.message), supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  return redirectWithCookies(createSuccessUrl(request, next), supabaseResponse);\n}",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // If no email identity, redirect to verify email page\n  // Treat errors as \"no identity\" to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n  const emailIdentityCheck = await safeCheck(\n    () =&gt; hasEmailIdentity(supabase),\n    \"hasEmailIdentity\",\n  );\n  if (!emailIdentityCheck.ok) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/verify-email\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check for linked profile if user is authenticated and not on public routes\n  // Skip this check for verify-email and pending-approval routes\n  // Treat errors as \"no profile\" to preserve graceful redirect behavior\n  const linkedProfileCheck = await safeCheck(\n    () =&gt; hasLinkedProfile(supabase),\n    \"hasLinkedProfile\",\n  );\n  if (!linkedProfileCheck.ok) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/pending-approval\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Strip all query parameters (e.g., from email verification or QR code)\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Strip hash as well\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // IMPORTANT: You *must* return the supabaseResponse object as it is.\n  // If you're creating a new response object with NextResponse.next() make sure to:\n  // 1. Pass the request in it, like so:\n  //    const myNewResponse = NextResponse.next({ request })\n  // 2. Copy over the cookies, like so:\n  //    myNewResponse.cookies.setAll(supabaseResponse.cookies.getAll())\n  // 3. Change the myNewResponse object to fit your needs, but avoid changing\n  //    the cookies!\n  // 4. Finally:\n  //    return myNewResponse\n  // If this is not done, you may be causing the browser and server to go out\n  // of sync and terminate the user's session prematurely!\n\n  return supabaseResponse;\n}",

        "contents": "export function useEmailVerificationRealtime() {\n() =&gt; {\nconst setupRealtimeSubscription = async \n\n\n        channelRef.current = channel;\n\n        // Listen for verified_work_email_changed events\n        channel.on(\n          \"broadcast\",\n          { event: \"verified_work_email_changed\" },\n          async (payload) =&gt; {\n            if (!mounted) return;\n\n            try {\n              // Refresh session to get updated user data\n              const { error: refreshError } = await supabase.auth.refreshSession();\n\n              if (refreshError) {\n                console.error(\"Failed to refresh session:\", refreshError);\n                return;\n              }\n\n              // Get current pathname to determine if we should redirect\n              const currentPath = window.location.pathname;\n\n              // If user is on verify-email page, redirect to default logged-in page\n              // Otherwise, refresh the current page to show updated state\n              if (currentPath === \"/auth/verify-email\") {\n                router.push(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n              } else {\n                // Refresh current page to show updated verification status\n                router.refresh();\n              }\n            } catch (error) {\n              console.error(\"Error handling verification change:\", error);\n            }\n          }\n        );\n\n        // Set auth before subscribing (required for private channels)\n        await supabase.realtime.setAuth();\n\n        // Subscribe to channel\n        const subscribePromise = channel.subscribe((status, err) =&gt; {\n          if (status === \"SUBSCRIBED\") {\n            isSubscribedRef.current = true;\n          } else if (status === \"CHANNEL_ERROR\") {\n            console.error(\"Channel subscription error:\", err);\n            isSubscribedRef.current = false;\n          } else if (status === \"CLOSED\") {\n            isSubscribedRef.current = false;\n          }\n        });\n\n        // Wait for subscription to complete\n        await subscribePromise;\n      } catch (error) {\n        console.error(\"Error setting up Realtime subscription:\", error);\n      }\n    };\n\n    // Set up subscription\n    setupRealtimeSubscription();\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async \n\n      }\n\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser(\n        {\n          email: email.trim(),\n        },\n        {\n          emailRedirectTo: redirectUrl,\n        },\n      );\n\n      if (updateError) {\n        // If email already exists, that's actually fine - it means it might already be linked\n        // or we need to handle it differently\n        if (updateError.message?.includes(\"already registered\")) {\n          setError(\"This email is already registered. Please use a different email or sign in with that email.\");\n        } else {\n          setError(updateError.message || \"Failed to send OTP code\");\n        }\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Update suggested_work_email in public.users table\n      // This enables cross-device synchronization and persistence\n      // The trigger will automatically set last_otp_sent_at\n      const { error: userUpdateError } = await supabase\n        .from(\"users\")\n        .update({ suggested_work_email: email.trim() })\n        .eq(\"auth_user_id\", (await supabase.auth.getUser()).data.user?.id);\n\n      if (userUpdateError) {\n        // Log error but don't block the flow - OTP was sent successfully\n        console.error(\"Failed to update suggested_work_email:\", userUpdateError);\n      }\n\n      // Move to OTP verification step\n      setStep(\"otp\");\n      savePersistedState({ step: \"otp\", email: email.trim() });\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    } catch (err) {\n      setError(\"An unexpected error occurred\");\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  /**\n   * Verifies the OTP code and links email identity to user\n   * Uses type 'email_change' since we're updating the user's email via updateUser()\n   * With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n   * to the existing authenticated user account\n   */\n}",

        "contents": "   - No Row Level Security policies\n   - No database triggers or functions\n   - All access control handled by Next.js\n\n### Next.js (Application Layer - All Business Logic)\n\n1. **Middleware Verification**:\n\n   - Queries &#96;profiles&#96; table for linked user_id\n   - Checks &#96;removed_access&#96; is null for active access\n   - Enforces role-based route protection\n   - Real-time verification (instant access revocation)\n\n2. **Domain Validation** (in server actions):\n\n   - Client-side validation for UX (immediate feedback)\n   - Server-side validation before sending OTP\n   - Validates email format and CZU domain\n\n3. **Access Management** (in server actions):\n\n   - Admin sets &#96;removed_access&#96; timestamp and &#96;removed_access_by&#96; profile\n   - Immediate effect on next request\n   - Audit trail of who revoked access and when\n\n## Authentication Flow Details\n\n### Step 1: Google Login\n\nUser clicks Google login button, Supabase handles OAuth flow.\n\n### Step 2: Work Email Input with Domain Validation\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// Validate domain before sending OTP\nif (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(workEmail)) {\n  throw new Error('Email must be @studenti.czu.cz or @pef.czu.cz');\n}\n\n// Send OTP to work email (only after domain validation passes)\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  options: { shouldCreateUser: false }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Step 3: OTP Verification and Profile Linking\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// After user enters OTP, verify it\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.verifyOtp({\n  email: workEmail,\n  token: otpCode,\n  type: 'email'\n});\n\n// Check if profile exists for this work email\nconst { data: profile } = await supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .select('id')\n  .eq('work_email', workEmail)\n  .single();\n\nif (!profile) {\n  // No profile exists - redirect to pending approval\n  redirect('/auth/pending-approval');\n}\n\n// Link profile to current user\nconst { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\nawait supabase\n  .from('profiles')\n  .update({ \n    user_id: user.id,",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n\n\n  /**\n   * Loads persisted state from sessionStorage after component mounts (client-side only)\n   * This prevents hydration mismatches between server and client\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const persisted = loadPersistedState();\n\n    // Validate persisted state - if on OTP step but no email, reset to email step\n    if (persisted.step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; (!persisted.email || !persisted.email.includes(\"@\"))) {\n      setStep(\"email\");\n      setEmail(\"\");\n      clearPersistedState();\n      setIsHydrated(true);\n      return;\n    }\n\n    // Restore persisted state if valid\n    if (persisted.email &amp;&amp; persisted.email.includes(\"@\")) {\n      setEmail(persisted.email);\n    }\n    if (persisted.step === \"email\" || persisted.step === \"otp\") {\n      setStep(persisted.step);\n    }\n\n    setIsHydrated(true);\n  }, []);\n\n  /**\n   * Persists email changes to sessionStorage\n   * Only saves when we have a valid email address and after hydration\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // Don't persist until after hydration to avoid hydration mismatches\n    if (!isHydrated) return;\n\n    if (email &amp;&amp; email.includes(\"@\")) {\n      savePersistedState({ step, email });\n    } else if (step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; !email) {\n      // If on OTP step but no email, clear invalid state\n      clearPersistedState();\n    }\n  }, [email, step, isHydrated]);\n\n  /**\n   * Auto-submits the form when OTP code reaches the expected length\n   * This handles paste events and manual entry\n   * Prevents re-submission of the same OTP code after a failed verification\n   */\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    const trimmedOtp = otpCode.trim();\n    const isOtpComplete = trimmedOtp.length === OTP_LENGTH;\n    const isNewOtp = trimmedOtp !== lastSubmittedOtp;\n\n    if (step === \"otp\" &amp;&amp; isOtpComplete &amp;&amp; !isLoading &amp;&amp; isNewOtp) {\n      verifyOTP();\n    }\n  }, [otpCode, step, isLoading, lastSubmittedOtp, verifyOTP]);\n\n  return (\n    &lt;Card&gt;\n      &lt;CardHeader&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "/**\n * Form component for email verification via OTP\n * Allows users to link an email identity to their Google OAuth account\n */\nexport function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [otpCode, setOtpCode] = useState(\"\");\n  const [step, setStep] = useState&lt;\"email\" | \"otp\"&gt;(\"email\");\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [isHydrated, setIsHydrated] = useState(false);\n  const [lastSubmittedOtp, setLastSubmittedOtp] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const supabase = createClient();\n\n  /**\n   * Sends OTP code to the provided email\n   * Uses updateUser to add email identity to the current authenticated user\n   * This is the correct way to link an email identity to an existing OAuth account\n   */\n  const handleSendOTP = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n;\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { useEmailVerificationRealtime } from \"@/lib/hooks/use-email-verification-realtime\";\n\n/**\n * Client component that sets up Realtime subscription for email verification\n * Must be used in a client component context (not in server components)\n * \n * This component listens for verified_work_email changes and automatically\n * refreshes the session and redirects when verification completes on any device\n */\nexport function EmailVerificationRealtimeListener() {\n  useEmailVerificationRealtime();\n  \n  // This component doesn't render anything - it's just a side effect wrapper\n  return null;\n}",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { useEffect, useRef } from \"react\";\nimport { useRouter } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\n\n/**\n * Custom hook that listens for verified_work_email changes via Realtime\n * Enables cross-device synchronization when email verification completes\n * \n * When verified_work_email changes on any device:\n * - Refreshes the auth session to get updated user data\n * - Redirects to the default logged-in page (or stays on current page if already there)\n * \n * This allows users to:\n * - Request OTP on one device and verify on another (both devices get logged in)\n * - Request OTP on one device and log in on another (user returns to where they were)\n */\nexport function useEmailVerificationRealtime() {\n  const router = useRouter();\n  const supabase = createClient();\n  const channelRef = useRef&lt;ReturnType&lt;typeof supabase.channel&gt; | null&gt;(null);\n  const isSubscribedRef = useRef(false);\n\n  useEffect(() =&gt; {\n    // Prevent multiple subscriptions\n    if (isSubscribedRef.current) {\n      return;\n    }\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "export function VerifyEmailForm({ next }: { next?: string }) {\nconst handleSendOTP = async  {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    setError(null);\n    setIsLoading(true);\n\n    try {\n      // Check if user already has a linked profile\n      // Once linked, email changes are not allowed to maintain profile connection\n      const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n      if (hasProfile) {\n        setError(\"Cannot change email address once linked to a profile. Your email is used to maintain your profile connection.\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate email format\n      if (!email || !email.includes(\"@\")) {\n        setError(\"Please enter a valid email address\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Validate CZU domain\n      if (!isValidWorkEmailDomain(email.trim())) {\n        setError(\"Email must end with @pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz\");\n        setIsLoading(false);\n        return;\n      }\n\n      // Use updateUser to add email identity to existing authenticated user\n      // This sends a verification link to the email address\n      // With enable_manual_linking = true, this will link the email identity\n      // Note: This adds the email as a secondary identity, not changing the primary email\n\n      // Construct the redirect URL with next parameter if available\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; so Supabase can append token_hash\n      const confirmUrl = new URL(&#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/confirm-email-change&#96;);\n      if (next) {\n        confirmUrl.searchParams.set(\"next\", next);\n      }\n\n      // Ensure URL ends with ? or &amp; for token_hash to be appended\n      let redirectUrl = confirmUrl.toString();\n      if (confirmUrl.search === \"\") {\n        // No query parameters, add ? for token_hash\n        redirectUrl += \"?\";\n      } else {\n        // Has query parameters, ensure it ends with &amp; for token_hash\n        if (!redirectUrl.endsWith(\"&amp;\")) {\n          redirectUrl += \"&amp;\";\n        }\n      }\n\n      const { data: updateData, error: updateError } = await supabase.auth.updateUser\n;\n;\n}",

        "contents": "import { redirect } from \"next/navigation\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { hasEmailIdentity, hasLinkedProfile } from \"@/lib/auth-helpers\";\nimport { DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE } from \"@/lib/constants/auth\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport { LogoutButton } from \"@/components/logout-button\";\n\n/**\n * Pending approval page\n * Shown to users who have verified their email but don't have a linked profile yet\n */\nexport default async function PendingApprovalPage() {\n  const supabase = await createClient();\n  const { data } = await supabase.auth.getClaims();\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!data?.claims) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/login\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to verify email if no email identity linked\n  const hasEmail = await hasEmailIdentity(supabase);\n  if (!hasEmail) {\n    redirect(\"/auth/verify-email\");\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to protected if already has linked profile\n  const hasProfile = await hasLinkedProfile(supabase);\n  if (hasProfile) {\n    redirect(DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE);\n  }\n\n  // Get user's email address\n  const { data: { user } } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const userEmail = user?.email || \"your email\";\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className=\"flex min-h-svh w-full items-center justify-center p-6 md:p-10 relative\n}",

        "contents": "  v_domain text;\nbegin\n  -- Determine which email to use: prefer new.email, fall back to email_change if email didn't change\n  -- When email_change is verified, Supabase typically:\n  -- 1. Sets email_change to the new email (temporary)\n  -- 2. Verifies OTP\n  -- 3. Moves email_change to email and clears email_change\n  -- So we need to check both fields\n  \n  -- Check if email changed\n  if old.email is distinct from new.email then\n    v_email := new.email;\n  -- Check if email_change was cleared (moved to email)\n  elsif old.email_change is distinct from new.email_change and (new.email_change is null or new.email_change = '') then\n    -- email_change was cleared, use the current email\n    v_email := new.email;\n  else\n    -- No relevant change\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and not empty\n  if v_email is null or v_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Extract domain from email\n  v_domain := lower(split_part(v_email, '@', 2));\n  \n  -- Only update verified_work_email if domain is a CZU domain\n  if v_domain not in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz') then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Update verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at\n  -- This happens after OTP verification succeeds, so the email is verified\n  -- Only update if the email is different from what's already stored (or not set)\n  update public.users\n  set verified_work_email = v_email,\n      verified_work_email_at = now()\n  where id = v_user_id\n    and (verified_work_email is null or verified_work_email != v_email);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change() is 'Trigger function that automatically sets verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at in public.users when auth.users.email is successfully changed to a CZU domain (@pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz).         "contents": "  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change() is 'Trigger function that automatically sets verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at in public.users when auth.users.email is successfully changed to a CZU domain (@pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz). Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios. Runs after OTP verification succeeds.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on auth.users table to set verified work email when email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure email change is committed\n-- Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios\ndrop trigger if exists set_verified_work_email_on_change_trigger on auth.users;\n\ncreate trigger set_verified_work_email_on_change_trigger\nafter update of email, email_change on auth.users\nfor each row\nwhen (\n  (old.email is distinct from new.email) or \n  (old.email_change is distinct from new.email_change)\n)\nexecute function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change();\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- INITIAL DATA UPDATE\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Update existing users who already have a CZU email set\n-- This handles any existing data that should have verified_work_email set\nupdate public.users u\nset verified_work_email = au.email,\n    verified_work_email_at = au.updated_at\nfrom auth.users au\nwhere u.auth_user_id = au.id\n  and au.email is not null\n  and au.email != ''\n  and lower(split_part(au.email, '@', 2)) in ('pef.czu.cz', 'studenti.czu.cz')\n  and (u.verified_work_email is null or u.verified_work_email != au.email);",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Set verified work email when email change succeeds\n-- Purpose: Automatically sets verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at in public.users when auth.users.email is successfully changed to a CZU domain\n-- Affected tables: users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically after email change is committed, only for CZU domains (@pef.czu.cz or @studenti.czu.cz)\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to set verified work email when email change succeeds\n-- Updates public.users.verified_work_email and verified_work_email_at when auth.users.email changes to a CZU domain\n-- Watches both email and email_change fields to catch all verification scenarios\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\ncreate or replace function public.set_verified_work_email_on_change()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_email text;\n  v_domain text;\nbegin\n  -- Determine which email to use: prefer new.email, fall back to email_change if email didn't change",

        "contents": "export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {\n\n\n  // Allow public routes without authentication\n  if (isPublicRoute(pathname)) {\n    // Handle authenticated users visiting login page - redirect them\n    if (pathname === \"/auth/login\") {\n      // Use getUser() instead of getClaims() to validate the user actually exists\n      // getClaims() can return truthy values even with invalid/deleted users\n      const { data: { user }, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n\n      // Only redirect if we have a valid user (not just claims)\n      // This prevents infinite redirect loops when token is invalid but claims exist\n      if (!error &amp;&amp; user) {\n        // Get next parameter from query string\n        const next = request.nextUrl.searchParams.get(\"next\");\n\n        // Validate next parameter to prevent open redirects\n        const origin = request.nextUrl.origin;\n        const validatedNext = next ? validateRedirectUrl(next, origin) : null;\n        const redirectTo = validatedNext ?? DEFAULT_LOGGED_IN_PAGE;\n\n        const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n        url.pathname = redirectTo;\n        url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n        url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n        return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n      }\n    }\n    return supabaseResponse;\n  }\n\n  // Redirect to login if not authenticated\n  if (!user) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n    url.pathname = \"/auth/login\";\n    url.search = \"\"; // Clear existing search params\n    url.hash = \"\"; // Clear existing hash\n    url.searchParams.set(\"next\", fullPath);\n    return redirectWithCookies(url, supabaseResponse);\n  }\n\n  // Check if user has an email identity (not just OAuth providers like Google)\n  const { data: getUserData, error } = await supabase.auth.getUser();\n  const authUser = getUserData?.user;\n\n  if (error) {\n    console.error(\"supabase.auth.getUser error\", error);\n  }\n\n  if (!authUser) {\n    const url = request.nextUrl.clone();\n}",

        "contents": "## Architecture Overview\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart TD\n    subgraph auth_flow [Authentication Flow]\n        A[User clicks Google Login] --&gt; B[Google OAuth]\n        B --&gt; C[Redirect back with Google identity]\n        C --&gt; D{Profile linked to user?}\n        D --&gt;|No| E[Prompt for work email]\n        E --&gt; F{Domain is czu.cz?}\n        F --&gt;|No| G[Show domain error]\n        G --&gt; E\n        F --&gt;|Yes| H[Send OTP to work email]\n        H --&gt; I[User enters OTP]\n        I --&gt; J{Profile exists for work email?}\n        J --&gt;|No| K[Pending Approval Page]\n        J --&gt;|Yes| L[Link profile to user]\n        D --&gt;|Yes| M{Access revoked?}\n        L --&gt; M\n        M --&gt;|Yes| N[Show access revoked]\n        M --&gt;|No| O[Grant Full Access]\n    end\n\n    subgraph request_flow [Request Validation]\n        P[Incoming Request] --&gt; Q[Middleware queries database]\n        Q --&gt; R{Profile linked to user?}\n        R --&gt;|No| S[Redirect to verify email]\n        R --&gt;|Yes| T{removed_access is null?}\n        T --&gt;|No| U[Show access revoked]\n        T --&gt;|Yes| V[Allow access]\n    end\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Validation Flow\n\n**Two-stage validation:**\n\n1. **Before OTP (Domain Check)**: Validate email ends with &#96;@studenti.czu.cz&#96; or &#96;@pef.czu.cz&#96;\n\n   - Client-side: Immediate feedback\n   - Server-side: Validated before &#96;signInWithOtp&#96; is called\n\n2. **After OTP (Profile Linking)**: Check if a profile exists for the verified work email\n\n   - If profile exists with that work_email → link profile to auth.user\n   - If no profile exists → show \"Pending Approval\" (admin must create profile first)\n   - Checked on every request via middleware\n\n## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)\n\nTwo tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:\n\n1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions\n2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control\n\n**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.\n\nUse MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

          },
          {

            "lineNumber": 85
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 86
          },
          {
            "text": "## Database Schema (Supabase Migrations)",
            "lineNumber": 87
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 88
          },
          {
            "text": "Two tables with **no RLS** - all access control is handled in Next.js:",
            "lineNumber": 89
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 90
          },
          {
            "text": "1. **&#96;users&#96;** - Custom table to sync with auth.users (Google OAuth), synced via Next.js server actions",
            "lineNumber": 91
          },
          {
            "text": "2. **&#96;profiles&#96;** - User authentication profile data with role and access control",
            "lineNumber": 92
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 93
          },
          {
            "text": "**Important**: No Supabase functions, triggers, or RLS policies. All business logic lives in Next.js.",
            "lineNumber": 94
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 95
          },
          {
            "text": "Use MODDATETIME extension to set the &#96;updated_at&#96; column on every update.",

        "contents": "begin\n  -- Only proceed if verified_work_email actually changed\n  if old.verified_work_email is not distinct from new.verified_work_email then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n\n  -- Get the auth_user_id for this user record\n  v_user_id := new.auth_user_id;\n\n  -- If no auth_user_id, cannot broadcast\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n\n  -- Get old and new email values\n  v_old_email := old.verified_work_email;\n  v_new_email := new.verified_work_email;\n\n  -- Broadcast to user-specific channel: user:{auth_user_id}:verification\n  -- This allows all devices for this user to receive the notification\n  -- Function signature: realtime.send(payload jsonb, event text, topic text, private boolean DEFAULT true)\n  perform realtime.send(\n    jsonb_build_object(\n      'user_id', v_user_id,\n      'old_email', v_old_email,\n      'new_email', v_new_email,\n      'verified_at', new.verified_work_email_at,\n      'timestamp', now()\n    ),\n    'verified_work_email_changed',\n    'user:' || v_user_id::text || ':verification',\n    true -- private channel\n  );\n\n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.broadcast_verified_work_email_change() is 'Trigger function that broadcasts verified_work_email changes via Realtime to user-specific channel. Enables cross-device synchronization when email verification completes.';\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- TRIGGERS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger on users table to broadcast verified_work_email changes\n-- Runs AFTER UPDATE to ensure the change is committed\ndrop trigger if exists broadcast_verified_work_email_change_trigger on public.users;\n\ncreate trigger broadcast_verified_work_email_change_trigger\nafter update of verified_work_email on public.users\nfor each row\nwhen (old.verified_work_email is distinct from new.verified_work_email)\nexecute function public.broadcast_verified_work_email_change();\n\ncomment on trigger broadcast_verified_work_email_change_trigger on public.users is 'Broadcasts verified_work_email changes via Realtime to enable cross-device synchronization.';\n\n-- ============================================================================",

        "contents": "\"use client\";\n\nimport { cn } from \"@/lib/utils\";\nimport { createClient } from \"@/lib/supabase/client\";\nimport { Button } from \"@/components/ui/button\";\nimport {\n  Card,\n  CardContent,\n  CardDescription,\n  CardHeader,\n  CardTitle,\n} from \"@/components/ui/card\";\nimport { Input } from \"@/components/ui/input\";\nimport { Label } from \"@/components/ui/label\";\nimport Link from \"next/link\";\nimport { useState } from \"react\";\n\nexport function ForgotPasswordForm({\n  className,\n  ...props\n}: React.ComponentPropsWithoutRef&lt;\"div\"&gt;) {\n  const [email, setEmail] = useState(\"\");\n  const [error, setError] = useState&lt;string | null&gt;(null);\n  const [success, setSuccess] = useState(false);\n  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);\n\n  const handleForgotPassword = async (e: React.FormEvent) =&gt; {\n    e.preventDefault();\n    const supabase = createClient();\n    setIsLoading(true);\n    setError(null);\n\n    try {\n      // The url which will be included in the email. This URL needs to be configured in your redirect URLs in the Supabase dashboard at https://supabase.com/dashboard/project/_/auth/url-configuration\n      const { error } = await supabase.auth.resetPasswordForEmail(email, {\n        redirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/auth/update-password&#96;,\n      });\n      if (error) throw error;\n      setSuccess(true);\n    } catch (error: unknown) {\n      setError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : \"An error occurred\");\n    } finally {\n      setIsLoading(false);\n    }\n  };\n\n  return (\n    &lt;div className={cn(\"flex flex-col gap-6\", className)} {...props}&gt;\n}",

        "contents": "-- Migration: Link users to profiles based on email matching\n-- Purpose: Automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email\n-- Affected tables: profiles, users, auth.users\n-- Special considerations: Runs automatically when user email changes in auth.users table\n\n-- ============================================================================\n-- FUNCTIONS\n-- ============================================================================\n\n-- Create trigger function to link profiles to users based on email matching\n-- Matches auth.users.email with profiles.work_email and links via public.users\n-- Runs with SECURITY DEFINER to access auth.users table\ncreate or replace function public.link_user_to_profile()\nreturns trigger\nlanguage plpgsql\nsecurity definer\nset search_path = public, auth\nas $$\ndeclare\n  v_user_id uuid;\n  v_auth_email text;\nbegin\n  -- Get the email from auth.users (use NEW.email after update)\n  v_auth_email := new.email;\n  \n  -- Only proceed if email is not null and has changed\n  if v_auth_email is null or v_auth_email = '' then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Find the public.users row that matches this auth.users.id\n  select id into v_user_id\n  from public.users\n  where auth_user_id = new.id;\n  \n  -- If no matching public.users row found, return early\n  if v_user_id is null then\n    return new;\n  end if;\n  \n  -- Link profile to user if work_email matches auth.users.email\n  -- Only update if profile exists and is not already linked to a different user\n  -- Normalize both sides of comparison to handle case/whitespace differences\n  update public.profiles\n  set user_id = v_user_id\n  where lower(trim(work_email)) = lower(trim(v_auth_email))\n    and (user_id is null or user_id = v_user_id);\n  \n  return new;\nend;\n$$;\n\ncomment on function public.link_user_to_profile() is 'Trigger function that automatically links profile rows to user rows when auth.users.email matches profiles.work_email. Matches based on currently logged in user email (auth.users.email), uid in user table row (public.users.auth_user_id), and work_email in profile table row (public.profiles.work_email).';\n\n-- ============================================================================",
